_说明.用途: 写作洞察数据模板 — 填写真实数据后会由脚本转换成 WritingInsightData
_说明.数据粒度: 每一条记录 = 一个学生的一次作文批改结果

字段说明.writingType: 写作类型。可选值：practical(应用文) continuation(读后续写) sync_composition(同步作文) custom_correction(自定义批改) comprehensive_expression(书面表达)
字段说明.level: 等级。可选值：A B C D E
字段说明.problems: 本次作文发现的问题列表，可为空数组

problems字段说明.type: 问题类型。可选值：content_incomplete(内容不完整/要点缺失) structure_unclear(结构不清/段落组织弱) language_accuracy(语言准确性弱/语法错误多) vocabulary_weak(词汇表达弱/用词单一) sentence_monotony(句式单一/句子衔接弱) logic_cohesion(逻辑衔接弱/情节不连贯) format_issue(格式规范问题/应用文格式)
problems字段说明.explanation: 问题说明（为什么这是问题）
problems字段说明.improvedExample: 改进后的正确例句（可选）

填写要点: 不需要每个学生每篇作文都有问题——完全正确的作文 problems 留空数组即可
一篇作文可以有多个问题，但建议每篇 1-3 个主要问题
建议至少覆盖一个班级一次写作练习的数据（30-40 条记录）

problems.originalText: He go to school at seven.
problems.explanation: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，动词 go 应为 goes
problems.improvedExample: He goes to school at seven.

problems.originalText: I like eat apple very much.
problems.explanation: like 后应接动名词 eating，且 eat 用词过于简单
problems.suggestion: like eating → I enjoy eating / I am fond of
problems.improvedExample: I enjoy eating apples very much.

problems.originalText: My favorite food is chicken. I have a dog. Chicken is good.
problems.explanation: 段落跳跃太大，从食物突然跳到宠物再跳回食物，缺少逻辑衔接
problems.suggestion: 围绕食物主题展开，第二句可以描述为什么喜欢鸡肉
problems.improvedExample: My favorite food is chicken. It tastes delicious and is good for my health.

problems.originalText: I like chicken. I like rice. I like juice.
problems.explanation: 连续三个简单句都是 I like... 句式，缺乏变化
problems.suggestion: 使用不同句式表达，如 I also enjoy... / My favorite drink is...
problems.improvedExample: I like chicken best. I also enjoy rice, and my favorite drink is juice.

problems.originalText: Let me tell you about my favorite food. My favorite food is dumpling.
problems.explanation: 同步作文不需要书信格式的开头句，且 dumpling 应用复数 dumplings
problems.suggestion: 直接开头描述食物，dumpling → dumplings
problems.improvedExample: Dumplings are my favorite food. They are a traditional Chinese dish.

_excellentWritings_可选.说明: 如果有特别优秀的作文，可以单独列出作为范文参考。选填。

excellentWritings.highlights: 句式多样，逻辑清晰，词汇丰富准确
excellentWritings.excerpt: I enjoy eating dumplings because they are not only delicious but also represent the warmth of family gatherings.

_说明2: 以上为示例数据。填写后 records 数组多少个都可以，problems 数组也可空。
